source: Plan shapes follow the Gluten Velox backend documentation (https://apache.github.io/gluten/backends/velox/get-started/Velox.html): offloaded operators are *ExecTransformer nodes under VeloxColumnarToRowExec, a fallback shows GlutenRowToArrowColumnar or a vanilla ColumnarToRow, and AQE must be disabled for Gluten to validate the plan before execution.

plans.offloaded:
== Parsed Logical Plan ==
Aggregate [count(1)]

== Physical Plan ==
VeloxColumnarToRowExec
+- ^ RegularHashAggregateExecTransformer
   +- ^ FileSourceScanExecTransformer parquet
plans.vanilla:
== Parsed Logical Plan ==
Aggregate [count(1)]

== Physical Plan ==
*(1) HashAggregate(keys=[], functions=[count(1)])
+- *(1) ColumnarToRow
   +- FileScan parquet
plans.fallback:
== Physical Plan ==
VeloxColumnarToRowExec
+- ^ ProjectExecTransformer
   +- GlutenRowToArrowColumnar
      +- Scan hive default.table
plans.vanilla_transition_under_native:
== Physical Plan ==
VeloxColumnarToRowExec
+- ^ ProjectExecTransformer
   +- RowToColumnar
      +- Scan csv
plans.adaptive_not_yet_planned:
== Physical Plan ==
AdaptiveSparkPlan isFinalPlan=false
+- HashAggregate(keys=[], functions=[count(1)])
   +- FileScan parquet
plans.adaptive_with_offload:
== Physical Plan ==
AdaptiveSparkPlan isFinalPlan=false
+- VeloxColumnarToRowExec
   +- ^ RegularHashAggregateExecTransformer
